description: This file defines a singleton class 'DatabaseHelper' that manages access to a local SQLite database for a todo application, including database creation and connection handling.

classes.name: DatabaseHelper
classes.description: A singleton class providing access points for opening and managing a SQLite database for the todo app.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Returns an instance of the database, opening it if necessary.

methods.name: _openDatabase
methods.description: Handles the creation and opening of the database, including executing the table creation SQL.
